g.text: Show the name in the QR or the merchant
Describe it (what you found, what is blocked)
. Which one goes on the confirm screen and the
A. The registered name from the ITMX lookup
Look the merchant up before confirm and show the masked registered name, as for a transfer.
scope: One lookup call before the confirm screen
risk: Low: adds about 300 ms before confirm
B. The name in the QR (Tag 59)
No extra call: show the name the merchant printed in the QR.
risk: High: a fake QR can show any name
C. Both: the QR name, the registered name below it
risk: Low: a longer screen on small phones
